title: Exam Simulation: Tenses, Vocabulary ve Question Tags
subtitle: Son dersteki konularla gerçek sınav düzeninde prova yap.

learn.title: Önce ipucunu bul, sonra zamanı seç
learn.intro: Bu paket yalnızca son dersin sınav konularını kapsar. Her soruda önce zaman ifadesini, eylemin tamamlanıp tamamlanmadığını ve cümlenin odağını bul.

cards.title: Past simple
cards.text: Geçmişte başlayıp biten olaylar ve hikâyedeki art arda olaylar. Olumlu cümlede V2, soru ve olumsuzda did + V1.
examples: Maya missed the bus yesterday.
She called Leo and took a taxi.
Did she arrive on time?

cards.title: Past continuous
cards.text: Geçmişte belirli bir anda devam eden sahne veya başka bir olay olurken sürmekte olan eylem. was/were + V-ing.
examples: Maya was waiting at ten.
While she was waiting, it started to rain.
They were studying when the lights went out.

cards.title: Present perfect
cards.text: Zamanı belirtilmeyen deneyim, bugünkü sonuç veya geçmişten bugüne süren durum. have/has + V3.
examples: I have visited Ankara twice.
Leo has lost his ticket.
We have known Mina for years.

cards.title: Present perfect continuous
cards.text: Geçmişte başlayıp hâlâ süren veya yeni bitmiş fakat etkisi görülen aktivite. have/has been + V-ing.
examples: I have been studying since nine.
It has been raining all morning.
They have been waiting for two hours.

cards.title: when / while / since / for
cards.text: When kısa olayı veya zamanı; while devam eden iki eylemi bağlar. Since başlangıç noktası, for süre verir.
examples: I was reading when she called.
While I was reading, Leo was cooking.
since Monday
for three days

cards.title: Conjunctions
cards.text: Because sebep, so sonuç, but/although karşıtlık, and ek bilgi verir.
examples: I stayed home because I was ill.
The bus was late, so we called a taxi.
Although it was tiring, it was unforgettable.

cards.title: Question tags
cards.text: Olumlu cümleye olumsuz, olumsuz cümleye olumlu kısa soru eklenir. Yardımcı fiili ve özneyi cümleden al.
examples: You are ready, aren't you?
She didn't leave, did she?
They have arrived, haven't they?
Let's start, shall we?

cards.title: Used to ailesi
cards.text: Used to geçmiş alışkanlık; be used to alışılmış durum; get used to alışma sürecidir.
examples: I used to walk to school.
I am used to early mornings.
I am getting used to the new timetable.

read.title: The Delayed Journey
read.instructions: Metni sınav gibi oku. Önce ana fikri bul, sonra zamanları ve bağlaçları işaretle.

tokens.text: Arda has been preparing for a school contest for three weeks.
Yesterday, he was travelling to the event when the bus suddenly stopped at a crossroad.
The driver made an announcement because there was a problem with the engine.
While the passengers were waiting, Arda checked his backpack and noticed that he had all his materials.
The delay was exhausting, but Arda stayed calm.
The school rescheduled his presentation, so he did not miss the contest.
He has already received approval to present this afternoon.
It has been an unforgettable journey, hasn't it?

questions.prompt: How long has Arda been preparing?
questions.explanation: For + süre; present perfect continuous devam eden hazırlığı anlatır.

questions.prompt: What was Arda doing when the bus stopped?
options: He was travelling to the event.
questions.answer: He was travelling to the event.
questions.explanation: Devam eden sahne past continuous, araya giren olay past simple.

questions.prompt: Why did the driver make an announcement?

extra.title: A Festival Exam Text
extra.instructions: Metni oku; true/false ve ayrıntı sorularını metin kanıtıyla cevapla.
paragraphs: Mina has always been passionate about local festivals. This year, she has been helping a community team organise a seaside event. The team has put colourful banners near every crossroad and a large billboard beside the terminal. They have also negotiated a fair price for the food carts. Mina is responsible for the applicants who want to join the art contest. She has checked twenty forms since Monday, but she has not finished the approval process yet.

Last Saturday, the team tested the programme. While a procession was moving through the town, volunteers were carrying torchlights and visitors were watching a tug of war on the sandy beach. Suddenly, the weather changed. It started to rain, so the organiser rescheduled the prize-giving ceremony. Although the day was exhausting, everyone remained immersed in the activities. The desk clerk at the visitors’ accommodation said the view after the storm was breathtaking. The volunteers have learned an important lesson: they must prioritise safety, mustn't they?

questions.prompt: True or False: Mina has finished every application.
questions.explanation: Metinde approval process henüz bitmedi diyor.

questions.prompt: What happened while the procession was moving?
options: Visitors were watching a tug of war.
questions.answer: Visitors were watching a tug of war.
questions.explanation: While aynı anda devam eden iki eylemi bağlıyor.

questions.prompt: Why was the prize-giving ceremony rescheduled?

listening.title: Transport Announcements
listening.instructions: Bir kez ana bilgi için, ikinci kez saat-platform-kapı ayrıntıları için dinle.
listening.task: Duyduğun announcement, boarding ve terminal bağlamlarını not et. Değişen bir planı past simple ile yaz.
listening.followUp: Kayıttan iki doğru/yanlış sorusu hazırla ve bir question tag ekle.

questions.prompt: Which word means getting onto a plane?

options: The platform has changed, hasn't it?
The platform has changed, doesn't it?
questions.answer: The platform has changed, hasn't it?
questions.explanation: Present perfect cümlesinde yardımcı fiil has → hasn't.

options: Although it was raining, the procession continued.

4. Final Exam.answer: Although it was raining, the procession continued.
